description: Select customer.usageLimit on workspace so UsageLimit can observe soft/hard dollar caps (maxDepth 2 omitted the nested UsageLimit).

patches.value:
query workspace($workspaceId: String!) {
  workspace(workspaceId: $workspaceId) {
    adoptionHistory {
      adoptionLevel
      createdAt
      deltaLevel
      id
      matchedIcpEmail
      monthlyEstimatedUsage
      numConfigFile
      numCronSchedule
      numDeploys
      numEnvs
      numFailedDeploys
      numHealthcheck
      numIconConfig
      numRegion
      numReplicas
      numRootDirectory
      numSeats
      numServices
      numVariables
      numWatchPatterns
      totalCores
      totalDisk
      totalNetwork
      updatedAt
    }
    adoptionLevel
    allowDeprecatedRegions
    apiTokenRateLimit {
      remainingPoints
      resetsAt
    }
    avatar
    banReason
    createdAt
    customer {
      appliedCredits
      billingEmail
      creditBalance
      currentUsage
      defaultPaymentMethodId
      hasExhaustedFreePlan
      id
      isPrepaying
      isTrialing
      isUsageSubscriber
      isWithdrawingToCredits
      remainingUsageCreditBalance
      state
      stripeCustomerId
      supportedWithdrawalPlatforms
      trialDaysRemaining
      usageLimit {
        agentHardLimitCents
        agentSoftLimitCents
        customerId
        hardLimit
        id
        isOverLimit
        softLimit
      }
    }
    discordRole
    has2FAEnforcement
    hasAutomaticDiagnosis
    hasGuardrailsAccess
    hasHipaaBAA
    hasSAML
    id
    members {
      avatar
      email
      featureFlags
      id
      name
      role
      twoFactorAuthEnabled
    }
    name
    partnerProfile {
      category
      description
      slug
      type
      website
    }
    plan
    preferredRegion
    redactedDueTo2FAPending
    referredUsers {
      code
      id
      status
    }
    slackChannelId
    subscriptionModel
    subscriptionPlanLimit
    team {
      adoptionLevel
      avatar
      createdAt
      id
      name
      preferredRegion
      slackChannelId
      updatedAt
    }
    updatedAt
    usersWithout2FA
  }
}
